title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-25 01:46:47 最新章节：第2576章 提升灵气浓度
slug: 灵气复苏我有个吞噬系统
content_zh:
“肖严！通脉境三段！”
随着班主任的一声大喊，所有同学都是朝着那个名为肖严的投入了羡慕的目光。
你以为他是主角？
此刻坐在教室后边的丘凌风默默的流下了眼泪。
三天前，原本还在泡网吧的他神奇的穿越到了这个灵气复苏的世界。
灵气复苏，天地万物都可以修炼。
人族，自然也不例外，觉醒出了武者，抗衡那些日益强大的魔兽。
不过，武者的数量极为稀少。
一百个人之中，也难以出现一个武者。
丘凌风的前身也是如此，平平无奇的一个普通人，根本没有觉醒成为武者的资格。
不只是他，班上的大部分同学都是如此。
在这个世界的高中里，每个人都期望有朝一日觉醒成为武者，不过这个几率实在太小了。
肖严，很幸运的就是其中一位。
而且天赋也不差，十八岁的通脉境三段。
在这小小的新手村里，几乎找不到第二个能和他相抗衡的天才。
“明天，你们就要跟着村子里的巡逻队一起出去巡逻，五人一组，自由组队。”
班主任面无表情的说道，
“这是你们最后一次觉醒成为武者的机会了，有前辈做过研究，人族在面临生死危机之时，觉醒成为武者的概率更大。”
虽然班主任这样说，但是一众学生脸上都是挂上了恐惧之色。
要知道……

一旦跟巡逻队一起出去巡逻的话，一不小心可就会丧命了。
运气好点的，落个终身残疾也不是不可能。
只有那么一小部分的人，能够在紧要关头觉醒成武者。
因为，失败的人，大部分都死在了外面。
就算回到了村子中，以后也只能从事一些底层职业，讨个生计。
“散会。”
班主任说完，离开了教室。
顿时，班上仅有的已经觉醒成为武者的三人成了香饽饽。
跟这三人组一队，活下来的几率才更大！
丘凌风看着被乱成一团的教室，有些无奈的往后一靠。
嘭！
丘凌风直接摔在了地上。
靠！
倒是忘了这里的椅子没有靠背了！
content_en:
"Xiao Yan! Third level of Tongmai Realm!"
Following the class teacher's shout, all the students looked enviously at the person named Xiao Yan.
Do you think he is the protagonist?
Qiu Lingfeng, who was sitting at the back of the classroom, shed tears silently.
Three days ago, he was still in an Internet cafe and magically traveled to this world where spiritual energy was revived.
When spiritual energy is revived, all things in the world can be cultivated.
The human race, of course, is no exception. Warriors have awakened to compete with the increasingly powerful monsters.
However, the number of warriors is extremely rare.
Among a hundred people, it is difficult for a warrior to appear.
The same was true for Qiu Lingfeng's predecessor. He was an ordinary person who had no qualifications to awaken as a warrior.
Not just him, but most of the students in the class.
In high schools in this world, everyone hopes to awaken as a warrior one day, but the chance of this is too small.
Xiao Yan is very lucky to be one of them.
And his talent is not bad either, he is in the third level of Tongmai Realm at the age of eighteen.
In this small novice village, it is almost impossible to find another genius who can compete with him.
"Tomorrow, you will go out on patrol with the patrol team in the village, in groups of five, forming groups freely."
The head teacher said expressionlessly,
"This is your last chance to awaken as a warrior. Some seniors have done research. When the human race faces a life and death crisis, the probability of awakening as a warrior is greater."
Although the head teacher said this, all the students had a look of fear on their faces.
You know...
Once you go out on patrol with the patrol team, you may die if you are not careful.
If you are lucky, it is not impossible to become permanently disabled.
Only a small number of people can awaken as warriors at a critical moment.
Because most of those who failed died outside.
Even if he returns to the village, he will only be able to work in some low-level occupations to make a living.
"Meeting dismissed."
After the head teacher finished speaking, he left the classroom.
Suddenly, the only three people in the class who had awakened to become warriors became the most popular ones.
If you form a team with these three people, you will have a greater chance of survival!
Qiu Lingfeng looked at the chaotic classroom and leaned back helplessly.
Bang!
Qiu Lingfeng fell directly to the ground.
Depend on!
I forgot that the chairs here don’t have backrests!
